study type: Quality Improvement Study with pre/post-intervention audits
outcome: Documentation of indications for induction of labor
Use of Foley catheters during induction
Neonatal admission to special care units
cohort: Patients undergoing induction of labor at a tertiary care hospital in Sri Lanka.
finding: A quality improvement initiative successfully enhanced evidence-based practices and person-centered care during induction of labor, leading to improved documentation, assessments, and neonatal outcomes, despite an observed increase in caesarean section rates.
mod_finding: An increase in caesarean section rates was noted from 22.3% to 35.4% following the intervention.
